title: Worked great ... for awhile ...
text:
Worked great ... for awhile .... Bought this awhile ago and it seemed to work great for awhile. After about 8 months, though, the plastic top cracked vertically while I was screwing it back on after washing. I wasn't forcing it at all -- I had been very careful with it from the time I got it -- just putting the top back on it and pop! it broke.

Too bad, really. It had been a nice oil bottle up to that point. Still looking for an oil bottle that doesn't leak!
